https://www.xbox.com/games/store/stage-tour/9p0pw4lvx6v2 

Digital pre-orders for Stage Tour are now available on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC! 

Pre-order the Digital Edition and save 10% ahead of launch on December 10, 2026. 

No instrument controller required. Rock out with an XBOX Wireless Controller, plug in a compatible legacy guitar controller, or take the stage with the new range of official Stage Tour hardware.

Play solo or with up to four players locally, online, or cross-platform. 
Featuring 90+ officially licensed songs, 180+ authentic in-game Gibson, Epiphone and Kramer guitars, 50+ bandmates, and more. Get ready to rock out to Metallica, The Rolling Stones, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Olivia Rodrigo, blink-182, Paramore, Slipknot, Muse, and many more. 

Pre-order Stage Tour now on XBOX Series X|S or XBOX on PC.
